title: HeliCAT (Helicopter Cardiac Arrest Team) - optimized individualized CPR
summary: In 2 studies using specialized ECMO cars could show, that the standard compression point was not ideal in 40-80%. We want to show that a standard HEMS crew is able to optimize the location of the compression point with transesophageal ultrasound to improve the blodflow.

interventions.name: After Team-Arrival at a patient with cardiac arrest the standardized treatment according to the ERC guidelines (as ventilation, chest compression, defibrillationn) is continued. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Cardiac arrest due to internal causes (ECG rhythm ventricular fibrillation, pulseless electrical activity, asystole)
•	Age >=18 years
•	time from collapse to start of CPR < 10min 
•	no signs of death
•	Inclusion due to discretion of the HEMS physician on duty
Exclusion criteria:
•	traumatic cardiac arrest
•	Stopping of CPR by the HEMS team due to bad prognosis  ( >10 Minutes no flow, no lay CPR, unwitnessed arrest) in 5min Minutes after HEMS arrival
•	Known esophageal pathology
•	No admission to the university hospitals Mannheim or Heidelberg possible
•	Signs of death
